title: The vapour + liquid condenser at its limits: a vapour share of 0.001 against a total condenser, of 0.999 against a partial one; a temperature above the top vapour's dew point
purpose: Proposal 0026, case 2. With a vapour share of 0.001 (reflux ratio L1 / U1 and the whole distillate given) the column approaches the total condenser's with the same reflux ratio and distillate; with 0.999 (boil-up ratio and distillate given) the partial condenser's. A condenser temperature above the top vapour's dew point leaves no liquid: refused (OUT_OF_RANGE).
method_choice: constant-alpha model system (no method to choose)

thermo.note: A3's model system (validation/data/columns/A3-ternary-partial-condenser.json) with a fourth, light component G (relative volatility 40) that the condenser does not fully condense. A model system, not a real mixture: K_i = alpha_i p(T) / P, liquid enthalpy 0 and vapour enthalpy the latent heat for every component (constant molar overflow). docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md does not apply.

refused.why: above the dew point of the top vapour (about 316 K by the reference below): no liquid in the condenser

limits.why: this project's choice: a share of 0.001 (0.999) moves 0.1 % of the distillate between the two outlets, so the profiles differ by about that share

engine_against_reference.why: As A3: both solve the same equations to residuals of 1e-10 or less; the difference is the solvers' convergence only.
